Frame Row Marking

Hang a row of frames on a measured wall: enter the usable width, each frame’s size and its back hook offset, and get the equal-gap layout plus every hook reading from one wall origin, ready to mark with a tape measure.

Data stays on this page; nothing is uploaded or stored. Leaving the page clears the draft.

    Alignment

    With center alignment, Y is measured down from the top edge of the tallest frame.

    Frames

    Enter left to right. One hook per frame; the hook offset is seen from the front of the frame, and a hook may sit on the frame edge. 2–12 frames.
